name: Cats & Carnations
source:
You get an email asking you to restore paintings in an old, inherited mansion. While uncovering these pieces of art, you get to know the owner and there might just be more behind to him than expected...

[From [url=https://fairyfaybug.itch.io/cats-carnations]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你收到一封电子邮件，要求你修复一栋继承下来的古老宅邸中的画作。在揭开这些艺术品的过程中，你会了解主人，而且他背后可能隐藏着比预期更多的东西……

[来自[url=https://fairyfaybug.itch.io/cats-carnations]itch.io[/url]]
